severity: error
timestamp: 2026-05-30T21:32:12Z

findings:
entity-graph is emitting a repeating WARNING every 30s: "saw N source_document_persisted records but found 0 8-K documents to process — check form/source_type/url detection logic". This is occurring across ALL 846 persisted documents (9 tickers: MSTR 212, AAPL 149, IBKR 128, BRK.B 86, BEN 78, LLY 66, NVDA 61, GOOG 52, BLK 14). Entity-graph can see the source_document_persisted events but cannot match any of them as 8-K filings. Only a small handful of older AAPL and IBKR records processed before this condition set in. The signal store is completely empty — zero directors, zero proposals, zero signals of any type despite 846 documents in the store. Root cause is almost certainly a field name mismatch, casing difference, or missing field in the serialised source documents — e.g. the processo

suggested_fix:
1. In internal/entitygraph/reader.go (or equivalent), find the 8-K form type filter and make it case-insensitive: strings.EqualFold(doc.FormType, '8-K') or match on '8-k', '8-K', '8K' variants. 2. Add a debug log line that prints the actual form_type/source_type field value from the first few source_document_persisted records so the mismatch is immediately visible. 3.
